results.title: Áramótaskaup: 2024
results.overview: 2024 Áramótaskaup, an annual Icelandic TV movie, satirizing the events of the past year

results.title: Skin
results.overview: Displaced by the 1956 Hungarian Revolution, Anna has re-settled in rural Australia with a defeated husband and alienated son. After reluctantly renouncing her Hungarian nationality, Anna is haunted by her guilt, which manifests as a terrifying white presence that threatens to replace her.

results.title: Valkyries
results.overview: It is the year 2020 and the Corona pandemic has Germany firmly in its grip. Thus, the red-light business must also close its doors and the sex workers are driven onto the unsafe streets, where the situation is shamelessly exploited.

results.title: Christmas Eve in Miller's Point
results.overview: A family gathers on Christmas Eve for what could be the last holiday in their ancestral home. As the night wears on and tensions arise, one of the teenagers sneaks out with her friends to claim the wintry suburb for her own.

results.title: Buzz House: The Movie
results.overview: The next season of Buzz House is the most ambitious yet. Selly has prepared many surprises for the participants: secret competitors, an isolated villa in the forest that can only be reached by boat and a costumed employee, set to scare them, to have a thrilling exit. Everything is planned in detail. What's not in the plan, though, is for a real psychopath to show up, kill the "scary" employee, take his costume and terrorize our competitors for real. Do rivalries still matter when you're being run over with an axe? Do friendships still matter when you have to risk your life for them? Who will manage to escape and how?

results.title: Romina Smile
results.overview: Romina has been working as a promoter for more than 20 years and, about to turn 40, faces few and poorly paid job offers. Her last days at work take her to bars and events. He decides to leave it, but in a Buenos Aires with crisis and unemployment, he cannot re-enter the labor market.

results.title: Devon
results.overview: Devon's parents never stopped searching for answers after her disappearance from a notorious asylum. Years after the incident, a mysterious website draws five adventurers to the abandoned asylum where she was last seen.

results.title: The Assistant
results.overview: 13-year-old Clara works as her father’s assistant in an informal dental office, which is located above a Peruvian-Chinese restaurant. At lunch time, a new patient arrives who isn’t registered for an appointment that day, causing Clara suspicion.

results.title: Schlafende Pferde
results.overview: A workaholic advertising executive in her mid-30s begins to hear a voice in her head the day before a presentation, which attempts to shake up the banality of her everyday life. She views the outside world through sober eyes, while the protagonist's introspection and her romantic, nature-loving escapism describe a situation that initially seems hopeless.

results.title: Gen. Sex
results.overview: An awkward college student searches for love on a dating app while trying to navigate hook-up culture.

results.title: Inside a Spider
results.overview: A Moscow family is trying to hide from the chaos that's dragging the whole world into the black whirlpool of the apocalypse. But barricades in the corridor and hazmat suits won't help. Absurd and nightmares penetrate their haven through disturbing dreams full of lust, death and blood. Very soon they realize that strange mystical rituals with animals in the apartment won't save them. They haven't noticed how they crossed the line of normality. Thay have long been inside the deadliest spider on earth. The Devil, Stalin, Bill Gates, Madonna, the Russian Soldier and the Coffin Man are already on the threshold of their gloomy home.

results.title: Entrails of Savage Capitalism
results.overview: Toto, a twelve-year-old with the appearance of a monstrous humanoid creature, is determined to push his parents to the limit. How much torment is this family prepared to endure? Will the abusive son succeed in imposing his malicious whims on his parents?  In this abrasive satire, no limits will be unbreakable.

results.title: Wild Agent 2: Peach Assassination
results.overview: To achieve the goal of invading the global financial system, the TNT criminal organization kidnapped expert Fang Li. His wife Yamei, a former ATO agent who had retired, rejoined the organization to rescue her husband.

results.title: Cherry on Top
results.overview: Mara is a law student incapable of feeling emotions. How will she react, then, when she discovers that her rapist is a redeemed and happy man? How will she compare the law with her idea of justice?

results.title: Savages
results.overview: In Borneo, near the tropical forest, Kéria rescues a baby orangutang in the palm oil plantation where her father works. Kéria's cousin Selaï comes to live with them seeking refuge from the conflict between his indigenous tribe and the logging companies. Kéria, Selaï and the little orangutang, now named Oshi, will have to fight against their forest’s destruction.

results.title: When the Light Breaks
results.overview: When the light breaks on a long summer's day in Iceland. From one sunset to another, Una, a young art student, encounters love, friendship, sorrow and beauty.

results.title: The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular
results.original_title: The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular
results.overview: Hosted by Julianne Hough and Alfonso Ribeiro, The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular returns for its dazzling ninth year. This festive celebration features an enchanting lineup of new musical performances, filmed against the magical backdrops of Walt Disney World Resort in Florida, Disneyland Resort in California, and Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa in Ko’Olina, Hawaiʻi.

results.title: Identity
results.overview: The main character recovers consciousness after a terrifying accident and discovers that it is 2035. The last thing he can recall is his work for a corporation that created robotized systems.

results.title: Almost a Bride
results.overview: Marika is a young and beautiful girl, her family runs a fabric shop called White Peacock. Their life turns upside down when the train and the promise of the modern world arrives in their little hometown. However, not only the train arrives in the girl's life, but also two men: the rational and cunning Jenő Toll and the intelligent and dreamy Baron Pankotay. In Marika, the two men, new, strange feelings and family pressure break the usual balance. Marika must make a decision when the modern world threatens both the security and livelihood of her family. Her decision surprises everyone.
